newsitem.title: UK: UK monthly corporate insolvencies hit eight-yr low.
newsitem.headline: UK monthly corporate insolvencies hit eight-yr low.

text.p: The number of British firms to be hit by insolvency in a month fell to an eight-year low of 126 in January, 1997, international accounting firm Deloitte & Touche found in its latest study.

Companies in the manufacturing sector topped the list with 35 administrative receiverships appointments. Twenty six firms in the construction business were found in the list followed by 10 firms in finance and business services.
